g.text: The agent keeps every capability it came with. Only what it can reach changes, and one box decides.

svg.text: Agent, gateway, model and data, side by side on one machine

g.text: Shell, code and network all kept

svg.text: Copy it out directly, skipping the gateway
Refused at layer 1. The gateway never sees the attempt.

g.text: Stamps the tool name, forwards the call
One audit record per call, allowed or not
Reachable by the gateway. Not by the agent.
Policy, catalog and prompts, fetched per request
Data plane re‑derives the verdict before it serves
Policy brain. Words the verdict the rules reached.
It cannot change the verdict, and it does not choose the alternative.
Agent brain. Drives the agent. Decides nothing about access.
Same box, separate role, and it can be a much larger model.
Two layers, and neither wraps the other. An agent that
talks its way past the data rules still cannot reach a route
the network never opened. An agent that finds an open
route still cannot be handed data the gateway refused.
The rules decide. The model words it.
Both run beside the data, on the box above.
